en.s: An annular solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's ascending node of orbit on October 22, 2137 BC, with a magnitude of 0.9736. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Earth and Sun, completely or partially blocking the Sun for a viewer on Earth. An annular solar eclipse occurs when the Moon's apparent diameter is smaller than that of the Sun, blocking most of the Sun's light and causing it to appear as an annulus (ring).

zh.s: 公元前2137年10月22日，月球运行至升交点时发生日环食，食分为0.9736。日食发生时，月球运行到地球与太阳之间，从地球观测会完全或部分遮挡太阳。日环食发生时，月球视直径小于太阳，因此会遮住大部分阳光，使太阳呈现环状。

en.t: The male line of the Portuguese House of Burgundy becomes extinct with the death of King Fernando, leaving only his daughter Beatrice. Rival claimants begin a period of civil war and disorder
en.s: The Portuguese House of Burgundy (Portuguese: Casa de Borgonha) was a Portuguese noble house that ruled the County and later Kingdom of Portugal from its founding until the 1383–85 Portuguese Interregnum. The house was founded by Henry of Burgundy, who became Count of Portugal in 1096. His son, Afonso Henriques, was proclaimed King of Portugal following his victory at the Battle of Ourique in 1139, establishing the Afonsine dynasty (Dinastia Afonsina).

zh.t: 葡萄牙勃艮第王朝男性世系断绝，费尔南多国王去世后仅剩女儿比阿特丽斯；敌对继承人引发内战与动荡
zh.s: 葡萄牙勃艮第王朝（葡萄牙语：Casa de Borgonha）是葡萄牙的一个贵族王朝，从建立起一直统治葡萄牙伯国及后来的葡萄牙王国，直至1383至1385年葡萄牙王位空缺时期。王朝由勃艮第的亨利创立，他于1096年成为葡萄牙伯爵。他的儿子阿方索·恩里克斯在1139年奥里克之战获胜后被拥立为葡萄牙国王，由此建立阿方索王朝（Dinastia Afonsina）。

en.s: Krzysztof Radziwiłł's raid on Russia (Polish: Zagon Radziwiłla na Rosję) was a military raid on the Grand Duchy of Moscow led by Krzysztof Mikołaj "the Thunderbolt" Radziwiłł, Field Hetman of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, during the final stages of the Livonian War (1558–1583). The raid started in conjunction with the preparation for the Siege of Pskov.

zh.s: 克日什托夫·拉齐维乌对俄突袭（波兰语：Zagon Radziwiłła na Rosję）是立陶宛大公国野战统帅克日什托夫·米科瓦伊“雷霆”·拉齐维乌率军对莫斯科大公国发动的一次军事突袭，发生在1558至1583年利沃尼亚战争末期。此次突袭与普斯科夫围城战的准备工作同时展开。

en.s: Battle of Paniowce (also known as the Battle of Kamieniec Podolski) was a battle fought on October 22, 1633, near Paniowce in Podolia between Polish-Lithuanian forces and the Turks, supported by Moldavian and Wallachian troops, and the Buda Tatars. It took place during the Polish–Ottoman War (1633–1634).

zh.s: 帕尼奥夫采战役又称卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基战役，于1633年10月22日在波多利亚的帕尼奥夫采附近爆发。交战双方是波兰立陶宛联邦军队，以及得到摩尔达维亚、瓦拉几亚部队和布达鞑靼人支援的奥斯曼军队。战斗发生在1633至1634年波兰—奥斯曼战争期间。

en.s: The Battle of Liaoluo Bay (Chinese: 料羅灣海戰; pinyin: Liàoluó Wān Hǎizhàn) took place in 1633 off the coast of Fujian, China; involving the Dutch East India Company (VOC) and the Chinese Ming dynasty's navies. The battle was fought at the crescent-shaped Liaoluo Bay that forms the southern coast of the island of Kinmen.

en.s: The Battle of Dömitz took place on 22 October 1635, during the Thirty Years' War. A Saxon force led by von Baudissin was besieging Dömitz Fortress when it was surprised by a Swedish relief column under Patrick Ruthven. Baudissin's detachment was effectively destroyed, losing between 3,500 and 5,000 men, including 2,500 prisoners who were incorporated into the Swedish army.

zh.s: 德米茨战役于1635年10月22日在三十年战争期间爆发。冯·鲍迪辛率领的萨克森军队正在围攻德米茨要塞时，遭到帕特里克·鲁思文率领的瑞典援军突袭。鲍迪辛部队几乎全军覆没，损失3,500至5,000人，其中2,500名俘虏被编入瑞典军队。

en.s: The Battle of Filipów was fought on October 22, 1656 between forces of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Field Lithuanian Hetman Wincenty Korwin Gosiewski on one side, and on the other allied Swedish and Brandenburg-Prussia forces commanded by Gustaf Otto Stenbock and Prince Georg Friedrich of Waldeck. The battle ended with victory for the Swedish-Brandenburg-Prussian troops. After their victory in the Battle of Prostki, the Lithuanian - Tatar forces began widespread looting of the Duchy of Prussia. Soon afterwards, Crimean Tatar units, allied to Poland-Lithuania headed back to their homeland, and the Commonwealth army shrank to some 8,500.

zh.s: 菲利普夫战役于1656年10月22日爆发，交战双方一方是文森蒂·科尔温·戈谢夫斯基率领的波兰立陶宛联邦军队，另一方是古斯塔夫·奥托·斯滕博克和格奥尔格·腓特烈·冯·瓦尔德克亲王率领的瑞典与勃兰登堡—普鲁士联军。瑞典—勃兰登堡—普鲁士军队获胜。普罗斯特基战役胜利后，立陶宛—鞑靼军队开始大规模劫掠普鲁士公国。此后不久，与波兰立陶宛联邦结盟的克里米亚鞑靼部队返回故土，联邦军队缩减至约8,500人。

en.s: The siege of Pécs was fought from 14 to 22 October 1686, in the city of Pécs in southwestern Hungary, between the armies of the Ottoman Empire and of the Holy Roman Empire. After the castle of Buda was wrested from Ottoman rule in 1686, the Austrian army advanced to capture Pécs which was defended by Sarı Süleyman Pasha.

zh.s: 佩奇围城战于1686年10月14日至22日在匈牙利西南部城市佩奇进行，交战双方是奥斯曼帝国军队和神圣罗马帝国军队。1686年布达城堡脱离奥斯曼统治后，奥地利军队继续推进，攻打由萨勒·苏莱曼帕夏防守的佩奇。

en.s: The siege of Nöteborg was one of the first sieges of the Great Northern War, when Russian forces captured the Swedish fortress of Nöteborg (later renamed Shlisselburg) in October 1702. Peter the Great had assembled a force of 20,000 men for this task, and marched for ten days to his destination. About 12,000 of these men were positioned on the banks of the Neva river, where they camped until 6 October (N.S.). On that day, after giving command of the main force to Boris Sheremetev, he moved toward Nöteborg. After the Swedish commander, Wilhelm von Schlippenbach, refused to give up the fort immediately, the Russians began bombarding it. A final Russian assault on the fort was tactically unsuccessful, resulting in heavy casualties, but forced the fort's defenders to surrender on 22 October 1702.

zh.s: 诺特堡围城战是大北方战争最早的几场围城战之一。1702年10月，俄军攻占瑞典要塞诺特堡（后改名什利谢利堡）。彼得大帝为此集结了2万人的部队，行军10天抵达目的地。其中约12,000人部署在涅瓦河岸边，扎营至10月6日（新历）。当天，彼得将主力交由鲍里斯·谢列梅捷夫指挥，自己则前往诺特堡。瑞典指挥官威廉·冯·施利彭巴赫拒绝立即交出要塞后，俄军开始炮击。俄军最后一次突击战术上未能成功，伤亡惨重，但迫使守军于1702年10月22日投降。

en.t: The Russian Empire is proclaimed by Tsar Peter I after the Swedish defeat in the Great Northern War
en.s: The Russian Empire was an empire that extended across northern Eurasia from 1721 until the proclamation of the Russian Republic in 1917, forming the final era of Tsarist Russia and the wider Russian monarchy. At its height in the late 19th century, it covered about 22,800,000 km2 (8,800,000 sq mi), roughly one-sixth of the world's landmass, making it the third-largest empire in history, behind only the British and Mongol empires.

zh.t: 瑞典在大北方战争中战败后，彼得一世沙皇宣布成立俄罗斯帝国
zh.s: 俄罗斯帝国是1721年至1917年俄罗斯共和国成立期间横跨欧亚大陆北部的帝国，是沙皇俄国及更广泛俄罗斯君主制的最后阶段。19世纪末国土面积达到约2,280万平方公里（880万平方英里），约占世界陆地面积的六分之一，是历史上第三大帝国，仅次于大英帝国和蒙古帝国。

en.t: J. S. Bach led the first performance of the chorale cantata Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul), based on the communion hymn of the same name, in Leipzig
en.s: Johann Sebastian Bach composed the church cantata Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul), BWV 180, in Leipzig for the 20th Sunday after Trinity and first performed it on 22 October 1724. The chorale cantata is based upon Johann Franck's hymn "Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele", with a melody by Johann Crüger, a hymn for the Eucharist.

zh.t: 巴赫指挥《装点自己，亲爱的灵魂》首演
zh.s: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫在莱比锡创作教会康塔塔《装点自己，亲爱的灵魂》（BWV 180），以纪念三一主日后的第二十个主日，并于1724年10月22日首次演出。这首圣咏康塔塔以约翰·弗兰克创作、约翰·克吕格谱曲的圣餐赞美诗《装点自己，亲爱的灵魂》为基础。

en.t: Construction of the Ladoga Canal is completed in Russia
en.s: The Ladoga Canal (Russian: Лaдожский канал, romanized: Ladozhsky Canal) is a historical water transport route, now situated in Leningrad Oblast, linking the Neva and the Svir River so as to bypass the stormy waters of Lake Ladoga which lies immediately to the northwest.

zh.s: 拉多加运河（俄语：Лaдожский канал，罗马化：Ladozhsky Canal）是一条历史水运通道，现位于列宁格勒州，连接涅瓦河和斯维尔河，使船只可以绕开其西北侧风浪汹涌的拉多加湖。

en.s: The War of Jenkins' Ear was fought between Great Britain and Spain from 1739 to 1748. Most of the fighting took place in New Granada and the Caribbean Sea, with major operations over by 1742. It is considered a related conflict of the 1740 to 1748 War of the Austrian Succession.

zh.s: 詹金斯之耳战争是英国与西班牙于1739年至1748年间进行的战争。大部分战斗发生在新格拉纳达和加勒比海地区，主要军事行动于1742年前后结束。该战争通常被视为1740至1748年奥地利王位继承战争的相关冲突。

en.t: A two-week massacre of ethnic Chinese in Batavia, Dutch East Indies, came to an end with at least 10,000 people killed
en.s: The 1740 Batavia massacre (Dutch: Chinezenmoord, lit. 'Murder of the Chinese'; Indonesian: Geger Pacinan, lit. 'Chinatown tumult') was a massacre and pogrom of ethnic Chinese residents of the port city of Batavia (present-day Jakarta) in the Dutch East Indies. It was carried out by Dutch soldiers of the Dutch East India Company and allied members of other Batavian ethnic groups.

zh.t: 巴达维亚华人大屠杀结束
zh.s: 1740年巴达维亚大屠杀（荷兰语：Chinezenmoord，意为“杀害华人”；印度尼西亚语：Geger Pacinan，意为“唐人街骚乱”）是荷属东印度港口城市巴达维亚（今雅加达）发生的华人屠杀和暴动。屠杀由荷兰东印度公司的荷兰士兵及其他巴达维亚族群的盟友实施。

en.s: The siege of Lemnos in 1770 was part of the Aegean theatre of the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774). The Russian navy under the command of Count Alexei Grigoryevich Orlov, which besieged the castle of Myrina on Lemnos between August 4 and 22 October 1770, retreated to the island of Paros after the Russian siege forces were defeated by the Ottomans under the command of Cezayirli Gazi Hasan Pasha, who landed on the island.

zh.s: 1770年莱姆诺斯围城战是1768至1774年俄土战争爱琴海战场的一部分。阿列克谢·格里戈里耶维奇·奥尔洛夫伯爵指挥的俄国海军从1770年8月4日起围攻莱姆诺斯岛米里纳城堡，直到10月22日。俄军围城部队被杰扎伊尔利·加齐·哈桑帕夏率领、登陆该岛的奥斯曼军队击败后，撤往帕罗斯岛。

en.s: The Battle of Mamaroneck was a skirmish in the New York and New Jersey campaign of the American Revolutionary War fought on October 22, 1776, at Mamaroneck, Westchester County, New York. Following the retreat of George Washington's army to White Plains, British General William Howe landed troops in Westchester County, intending to cut off Washington's escape route. To cover the eastern flank of his army, Howe ordered Major Robert Rogers and his Rangers to seize the village of Mamaroneck which had been recently abandoned by the Continental army. On the night of October 22, 750 men under Colonel John Haslet attacked the British encampment.

zh.s: 马马罗内克战役是美国独立战争纽约与新泽西战役中的一次小规模交战，于1776年10月22日在纽约州韦斯特切斯特县马马罗内克发生。乔治·华盛顿的军队撤至怀特普莱恩斯后，英国将军威廉·豪在韦斯特切斯特县登陆，打算切断华盛顿的退路。为掩护军队东翼，豪命令罗伯特·罗杰斯少校及其游骑兵占领马马罗内克村；该村当时已被大陆军放弃。10月22日晚，约翰·哈斯莱特上校率领750人袭击英军营地。

en.s: The Battle of Red Bank (October 22, 1777) was a battle of the American Revolutionary War in which a Hessian force was sent to take Fort Mercer on the left bank (or New Jersey side) of the Delaware River just south of Philadelphia, but was decisively defeated by a far inferior force of Colonial defenders. Although the British did take Fort Mercer a month later, the victory supplied a sorely-needed morale boost to the American cause, delayed British plans to consolidate gains in Philadelphia, and relieved pressure on General Washington's army to the north of the city.

zh.s: 红岸战役于1777年10月22日爆发，是美国独立战争中的一场战斗。黑森军队奉命攻占特拉华河左岸（新泽西一侧）、费城以南的默瑟堡，却被人数远少于己方的殖民地守军决定性击败。一个月后，英国军队确实攻占了默瑟堡，但这场胜利极大鼓舞了美国一方的士气，拖延了英国巩固费城战果的计划，也减轻了华盛顿将军在费城以北所率军队的压力。

en.t: Northwest Indian War: Native American forces defeat the United States, ending the Harmar Campaign
en.s: The Northwest Indian War was an armed conflict for control of the Northwest Territory between the United States and a loose confederation of Native American peoples who called themselves the United Indian Nations but are better known today as the Northwestern Confederacy. The United States Army considers the conflict to be the first of the American Indian Wars.

zh.t: 西北印第安战争：美洲原住民部队击败美国，结束哈马尔远征
zh.s: 西北印第安战争是美国与一个松散的美洲原住民联盟之间为争夺西北领地控制权而进行的武装冲突。联盟成员自称“联合印第安民族”，如今更常被称为西北邦联。美国陆军将这场冲突视为美国印第安战争的第一场。

en.s: The Harmar campaign was an attempt by the United States Army to subdue confederated Native Americans nations in the Northwest Territory that were seen as hostile in Autumn 1790. The campaign was led by General Josiah Harmar and is considered a significant campaign of the Northwest Indian War. The campaign ended with a series of battles on 19–22 October 1790 near the Fort Miami and Miami village of Kekionga.

zh.s: 哈马尔远征是美国陆军于1790年秋季试图镇压西北领地内被视为敌对的原住民部族联盟的一次军事行动，由乔赛亚·哈马尔将军领导，是西北印第安战争中的重要行动之一。远征于1790年10月19日至22日在迈阿密堡和凯基翁加村附近的一系列战斗中结束。

en.s: The battle of Laval took place on 22 October 1793, during the war in the Vendée and saw Vendéen victory over republican troops. This is the first major battle of a particular episode of the war called the Virée de Galerne.

zh.s: 拉瓦尔战役于1793年10月22日在旺代战争期间爆发，旺代军击败共和军。这是该战争中一个特定阶段——“加莱讷之旅”——的首场重大战役。

en.s: The action of 22 October 1793 was a minor naval engagement fought in the Mediterranean Sea during the War of the First Coalition, early in the French Revolutionary Wars. During the engagement a lone British Royal Navy ship of the line, the 64-gun HMS Agamemnon, attacked the French Navy large frigate Melpomène, part of a larger squadron, off the coast of Sardinia.

zh.s: 1793年10月22日海战是第一次反法同盟战争期间、法国大革命战争初期在地中海发生的一场小规模海战。一艘英国皇家海军64炮战列舰“阿伽门农”号在撒丁岛沿岸袭击法国海军大型护卫舰“墨尔波墨涅”号，后者属于一支更大的舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Île Ronde was fought between a French Navy and Royal Navy squadron off Isle de France on 22 October 1794 during the East Indies theatre of the French Revolutionary Wars. It was fought over control of the waters around Isle de France, which was under blockade from the British squadron as French warships and privateers operating from the island posed a significant threat to vital British trade routes connected to British India and China.

zh.s: 法国海军和英国皇家海军舰队于1794年10月22日在法兰西岛（今毛里求斯）附近海域交战，史称朗德岛海战。这是法国大革命战争印度洋战场的一部分。双方争夺法兰西岛周边海域的控制权；该岛当时遭英国舰队封锁，从岛上活动的法国军舰和私掠船对英国连接印度和中国的重要贸易航线构成重大威胁。

en.s: The Revolt of Cairo was a rebellion that occurred on 21–22 October 1798 by inhabitants of Cairo against the French occupation. It was suppressed by the French Army of the Orient under Napoleon.

en.s: The Hispano-Moroccan War, also known as the Spanish–Moroccan War, the First Moroccan War, the Tetuán War, or, in Spain, as the African War (Spanish: La Guerra de África), was fought from Spain's declaration of war on Morocco on 22 October 1859 until the Treaty of Wad-Ras on 26 April 1860. en.s: The Blantyre mining disaster, which happened on the morning of 22 October 1877, in Blantyre, Scotland, was Scotland's worst ever mining accident. Pits No. 2 and No. 3 of William Dixon's Blantyre Colliery were the site of an explosion which killed 207 miners, the youngest being a boy of 11. It was known that firedamp was present in the pit and it is likely that this was ignited by a naked flame. The accident left 92 widows and 250 fatherless children. Blantyre was also the scene of two further disasters in 1878 and 1879.

zh.s: 布兰太尔矿难发生于1877年10月22日上午，地点在苏格兰布兰太尔，是苏格兰历史上最严重的矿难。威廉·迪克森的布兰太尔煤矿2号和3号矿井发生爆炸，造成207名矿工死亡，其中最年轻者年仅11岁。矿井已知存在瓦斯，很可能是明火引燃了瓦斯。事故留下92名寡妇和250名失去父亲的儿童。布兰太尔在1878年和1879年又发生了两起矿难。

en.s: The India–Pakistan war of 1947–1948, also known as the first Kashmir war, was a war fought between India and Pakistan over the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir from 1947 to 1948. It was the first of the India–Pakistan wars between the two newly independent nations; both were dominions within the British Commonwealth of Nations. Pakistan precipitated the war a few weeks after its independence by launching tribal lashkar (militias) from Waziristan, in an effort to capture Kashmir and to preempt the possibility of its ruler joining India. Hari Singh, the Maharaja of Jammu and Kashmir, was facing an uprising by his Muslim subjects in Poonch, and lost control in portions of the western districts. On 22 October 1947, Pakistan's Frontier tribal militias crossed the border of the state.

en.s: Since the partition of British India in 1947 and subsequent creation of the dominions of India and Pakistan, the two countries have been involved in a number of wars, conflicts, and military standoffs. A long-running dispute over Kashmir and cross-border terrorism have been the predominant cause of conflict between the two states, with the exception of the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, which occurred as a direct result of hostilities stemming from the Bangladesh Liberation War in erstwhile East Pakistan (now Bangladesh).

en.s: The Battle of Yongyu (영유永柔 전투), also known as the Battle of the Apple Orchard or the Battle of Yongju by the Australians who fought in it, took place between 21 and 22 October 1950 during the United Nations Command (UNC) offensive into North Korea against the Korean People's Army (KPA) that had invaded South Korea during the Korean War.

en.s: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia, and the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Myanmar and China to the northwest, Vietnam to the east, Cambodia to the southeast, and Thailand to the west and southwest. Laos has a population of more than 7.5 million, and its capital and most populous city is Vientiane.

en.s: The 1955 Scottish League Cup final was played on 22 October 1955, at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 10th Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Aberdeen and St Mirren. Aberdeen won the match 2–1, thanks to a goal by Graham Leggat and an own goal by Jim Mallan. The winning goal, scored 11 minutes from the end, was a wind-assisted cross.

zh.s: 1955年苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1955年10月22日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，是第10届苏格兰联赛杯决赛。阿伯丁对阵圣米伦，最终以2比1获胜，格雷厄姆·莱加特打入一球，吉姆·马兰自摆乌龙。比赛还剩11分钟时，阿伯丁打入制胜球，这是一记借助风势的传中球。

en.s: The 1957 FA Charity Shield was the 35th FA Charity Shield, an annual football match held between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. zh.s: 1957年英格兰慈善盾是第35届慈善盾赛。这项年度足球赛由上赛季足球联赛冠军和英格兰足总杯冠军对决。1957年10月22日，1956—57赛季足球联赛冠军曼彻斯特联队与同赛季足总杯冠军阿斯顿维拉在曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场交手。

en.t: Cuban Missile Crisis: President Kennedy, after internal counsel from Dwight D. Eisenhower, announces that American reconnaissance planes have discovered Soviet nuclear weapons in Cuba, and that he has ordered a naval "quarantine" of the Communist nation
en.s: The Cuban Missile Crisis, also known as the October Crisis in Cuba (Spanish: Crisis de Octubre), or the Caribbean Crisis (Russian: Карибский кризис, romanized: Karibskiy krizis), was a 13-day confrontation between the governments of the United States and the Soviet Union, when American deployments of nuclear missiles in the United Kingdom, Italy and Turkey were matched by Soviet deployments of nuclear missiles in Cuba.

zh.t: 古巴导弹危机：肯尼迪在艾森豪威尔私下建议后宣布美军侦察机发现古巴境内苏联核武器，并下令对这个共产主义国家实施海上“隔离”
zh.s: 古巴导弹危机又称古巴十月危机（西班牙语：Crisis de Octubre）或加勒比危机（俄语：Карибский кризис，罗马化：Karibskiy krizis），是美国和苏联政府之间持续13天的对峙。此前，美国在英国、意大利和土耳其部署核导弹，苏联则以在古巴部署核导弹作为回应。

en.s: The 1963 BAC One-Eleven test crash was a fatal accident of a British Aircraft Corporation prototype aircraft on 22 October 1963, near Chicklade in Wiltshire, England while it was undertaking a test flight. All seven crew members on board the BAC One-Eleven were killed.

en.s: The St Marylebone by-election of 22 October 1970 was held after Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) Quintin Hogg became a life peer. The seat was retained for the Conservatives by Kenneth Baker, who had lost his previous seat of Acton at the general election four months earlier; Baker would go on to represent the Mole Valley seat in Surrey and become a long-serving Cabinet minister.

zh.s: 圣玛丽勒本选区于1970年10月22日举行补选，此前保守党议员昆廷·霍格获封终身贵族。肯尼思·贝克为保守党保住该席位；他在四个月前的大选中失去了原来的阿克顿选区席位。此后，贝克代表萨里郡莫尔谷选区，并成为长期担任内阁大臣的政治人物。

en.s: The 1976 United States presidential debates were a series of debates held during the 1976 presidential election. The League of Women Voters organized four debates among the major party candidates, sponsored three presidential debates and one vice presidential debate. Three presidential debates were held between Republican nominee Gerald Ford and Democratic nominee Jimmy Carter. One vice presidential debate was held between their respective vice presidential running mates, Bob Dole and Walter Mondale.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Comoros on 22 October 1978 following the approval of a new constitution in a referendum earlier in the month. The only candidate was Ahmed Abdallah, who had been President at the time of independence, before being ousted in a coup on 2 August 1975, then reinstated following another on 13 May 1978, since which he had held the post of "Co-Chairman of the Politico-Military Directorate of the Federal and Islamic Republic of Comoros" alongside Mohamed Ahmed. He was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 科摩罗于1978年10月22日举行总统选举，此前该月早些时候的公投通过了新宪法。唯一候选人是艾哈迈德·阿卜杜拉。他在科摩罗独立时担任总统，1975年8月2日政变后被推翻，1978年5月13日再次政变后复职；此后，他与穆罕默德·艾哈迈德共同担任“科摩罗联邦伊斯兰共和国政治军事委员会联合主席”。阿卜杜拉未经竞争当选。

en.s: The Croydon North West by-election took place on 22 October 1981. It was caused by the death of Conservative Member of Parliament Robert Taylor on 18 June 1981. The Conservative Party selected John Butterfill, then vice-chairman of Guildford Conservative Association. The Labour Party, the runners-up at the 1979 general election, selected a local councillor, Stanley Boden. The Liberal Party had come a distant third in 1979, but the by-election came shortly after the formation of the Social Democratic Party (SDP), with whom the Liberals had entered into an electoral pact, the SDP-Liberal Alliance.

zh.s: 克罗伊登西北选区于1981年10月22日举行补选，起因是保守党议员罗伯特·泰勒于1981年6月18日去世。保守党选出时任吉尔福德保守党协会副主席约翰·巴特菲尔参选。工党提名当地市议员斯坦利·博登；他曾在1979年大选中排名第二。自由党在1979年选举中远远落后，但这次补选恰逢社会民主党成立后不久。自由党已与该党达成选举协议，组成社民党—自由党联盟。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1983 were the fourth world kickboxing championships hosted by W.A.K.O. and were organized by British P.K.A. principal Mike Haig. It was the second W.A.K.O. event to be held in London (the 1980 European championship was also held here) and was open to amateur male kickboxers only and featured two forms of kickboxing - Full-Contact and Semi-Contact. By the end of the championships West Germany was the top nation in terms of medals, with USA a close second and hosts Great Britain just behind in third. The event was held at the Wembley Centre in London, England, UK on Saturday, 22 October 1983.

zh.s: 1983年W.A.K.O.世界锦标赛是W.A.K.O.主办的第四届世界踢拳锦标赛，由英国职业空手道协会负责人迈克·黑格组织。这是W.A.K.O.第二次在伦敦举办赛事（1980年欧洲锦标赛也在此举行）。赛事只对业余男子踢拳选手开放，设有全接触和半接触两种形式。比赛结束时，西德奖牌榜排名第一，美国紧随其后，东道主英国位列第三。赛事于1983年10月22日星期六在英国伦敦温布利中心举行。

en.s: The 1983 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held to elect the governor of Louisiana. Incumbent Republican governor Dave Treen lost re-election to a second term, defeated by former Democratic governor Edwin Edwards. Edwards became the first governor since Earl Long to win non-consecutive terms. He also became the first to serve three full terms. Edwards and Treen had previously faced off against each other for governor in 1972.

zh.s: 1983年路易斯安那州州长选举旨在选出该州州长。时任共和党州长戴夫·特里恩竞选连任失败，败给前民主党州长埃德温·爱德华兹。爱德华兹成为继厄尔·朗之后首位非连续任期当选的州长，也是首位完整任满三届的州长。两人此前曾在1972年州长选举中交锋。

en.t: John Adams' opera Nixon in China premiered at the Houston Grand Opera
en.s: Nixon in China is an opera in three acts by John Adams with a libretto by Alice Goodman. en.t: Accession of Bartholomew I of Constantinople
en.s: Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew I (born Dimitrios Archontonis, 29 February 1940) is the current ecumenical patriarch of Constantinople, serving as the 270th successor of the Apostolic See of St. Andrew. Since his election on 22 October 1991, he has become the longest-serving Ecumenical Patriarch in history. As the primus inter pares (first among equals), he occupies the First See of the Eastern Orthodox Church, acting as the highest-ranking primate and the spiritual leader of Eastern Orthodox Christianity worldwide.

zh.t: 巴尔多禄茂一世就任君士坦丁堡牧首
zh.s: 普世牧首巴尔多禄茂一世（本名迪米特里奥斯·阿尔孔托尼斯，生于1940年2月29日）是现任君士坦丁堡普世牧首，也是使徒圣座第270任继承人。自1991年10月22日当选以来，他已成为历史上任职时间最长的普世牧首。作为“众中之首”（primus inter pares），他居于东正教第一主教座，是东正教排名最高的首席主教和全球东正教的精神领袖。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Côte d'Ivoire on 22 October 2000. Robert Guéï, who headed a transitional military regime following the December 1999 coup d'état, stood as a candidate in the election. All of the major opposition candidates except for Laurent Gbagbo of the Ivorian Popular Front (FPI) were barred from standing. The Rally of the Republicans (RDR) and Democratic Party of Côte d'Ivoire-African Democratic Rally (PDCI-RCA) boycotted the election in response to the exclusion of their candidates (respectively, Alassane Ouattara and Emile Constant Bombet) by the Supreme Court. en.s: The Irish presidential election of 2004 was set for 22 October 2004. However, nominations closed at noon on 1 October and the incumbent president, Mary McAleese, who had nominated herself in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution, was the only person nominated. en.s: Bellview Airlines Flight 210 was a scheduled Nigerian domestic passenger flight of a Boeing 737-200 airliner from Lagos to Abuja, operated by Lagos-based Bellview Airlines. On 22 October 2005, the aircraft nose-dived and crashed at high speed a few minutes after takeoff, killing all 117 people on board. en.t: Tropical Storm Alpha forms in the Atlantic Basin, making the 2005 Atlantic hurricane season the most active Atlantic hurricane season until surpassed by the 2020 season
en.s: The 2005 Atlantic hurricane season was a record-breaking, catastrophic, and deadly Atlantic hurricane season. It is the second-costliest hurricane season, just behind the 2017 season. It featured 28 tropical and subtropical storms, which was previously the most recorded in a hurricane season until the 2020 season. The United States National Hurricane Center named 27 storms, exhausting the annual pre-designated list, requiring the use of six Greek letter names, and adding an additional unnamed subtropical storm during a post-season re-analysis.

en.t: Raid on Anuradhapura Air Force Base
en.s: The Raid on Anuradhapura Air Force Base, code-named Operation Ellaalan, was a successful commando raid conducted on SLAF Anuradhapura an Air Force Base in Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam. The attack happened on 22 October 2007. At 3:15 AM a group of 21 LTTE commandos, most of them Black Tigers, who are known to be suicide bombers, attacked the air base. Shortly after the attack started the Tigers were supported by two light aircraft from the Air Tigers which conducted a bombing run on the base and escaped undamaged. 10 military personnel, including 2 Air Force officers, were killed in the attack and 22 were wounded.

en.t: India launches its first uncrewed lunar probe mission Chandrayaan-1
en.s: Chandrayaan-1 (; from Sanskrit: Chandra, "Moon" and yāna, "craft, vehicle") of the Chandrayaan programme, was the first Indian lunar probe. It was launched by ISRO in October 2008, and operated until August 2009. The mission consisted of an orbiter and an impactor. ISRO launched the spacecraft using a PSLV-XL (C-11) rocket on 22 October 2008 at 00:52 UTC from Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), at Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Fiji on 22 October 2021, in which members of parliament elected the president.
